title: What is AI? Practice
subject: Computer Science · Introduction to AI
instructions: Answer the three questions about how AI systems use rules and patterns. Use the hints if you get stuck. Your teacher will review your work.

questions.prompt: How many emails contain the word "win"? Type the number.

misconceptions.note: count only goes up when "win" is in the email.

hints: Read each email. Which ones contain "win"?
The loop adds 1 to count for each email that has the word. Check them one at a time.
A similar problem: in ["a b", "b c"], the word "b" appears in 2 emails. Now check "win".

questions.prompt: Does this program print the word hat or the word coat? Type the word.
hints: Which line runs when the condition is True, and which when it is False?
Is 20 greater than 25? That tells you which branch runs.
A similar problem: if temperature were 30, the condition would be True. Compare 20 in the same way.

questions.prompt: What number does this program print?
questions.code:
scores = [3, 5, 4]
total = 0
for s in scores:
    total = total + s
print(total / 3)

misconceptions.note: That is the total. The last line divides it by 3.

hints: First work out what total is after the loop.
Add the scores one at a time. Then divide by 3.
A similar problem: [2, 4] gives total 6, and 6 / 2 is 3. Do the same steps with three scores.
